_readme: Corrections applied to vendor calendar rows whose title is a category
rather than an event, or whose scheduled time is stated in the venue's
local zone rather than the vendor's.
Each entry MUST carry `authority` (who says so) and `source_url`. An
override with no attribution is just a different guess, so the loader
refuses to apply one. `local_time` + `venue_tz` are converted to
Eastern at load; when present they REPLACE the vendor timestamp,
because the vendor time is what was wrong.
`match` is a case-insensitive substring of the vendor title, scoped to

overrides.title: State Arrival Ceremony and Honor Guard Review
